recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
method: Heat oil and butter in a saucepan. Add leek and cook for 5 mins or until soft and golden
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 mins
Stir in Arborio rice until it is transparent.
Add ½ cup of stock/wine, stirring until absorbed. Continue adding stock ½ cup at a time until rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in parmesan and parsley and serve drizzled with balsamic vinegar

recipes.name: Pumpkin and bean curry
method: Spoon the thick coconut cream from the top of the tin into the wok, and heat until boiling. Add the curry paste, then reduce the heat and simmer, stirring, for 5 minutes, until the oil begins to separate,
Add the remaining coconut cream, stock and pumpkin, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the green beans and cook for a further 8 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender,
Gently stir in the soy sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar. Garnish with the coriander leaves and cashew nuts and serve with steamed jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Sweet potato risotto
method: Cook onion in oil until softened
Add sweet potato and rice
Add ½ cup stock
Stir until liquid is absorbed
Repeat addition of stock until sweet potato is cooked
Add parmesan and 2 Tbsp sage
Garnish with remaining sage and parmesan

recipes.name: Green Beans with Feta and Tomato
method: heat oil and cook onion until soft
Add garlic and ½ of oregano and cook for one minute
Add wine and cook for three minutes
Stir in tomato and cook uncovered for ten minutes
Add beans and cook covered for another ten minutes
Stir in balsamic vinegar, feta and remaining oregano

recipes.name: Cabbage and Leek with Mustard Seeds
method: Heat oil and butter together, add mustard seeds and cook until they start to pop.
Add leeks and cook gently for 5-8 minutes
Stir in cabbage and cook over low heat for 4 minutes or until it wilts and softens.
Season cabbage well with salt and pepper.
Add lemon juice and sour cream and cook for one minute longer.
Stir in parsley and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Kedgeree
method: Flake fish.
Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add onion and cook until clear.
Add rice and fish and heat through.
Chop egg. Add to saucepan,
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
When kedgeree is very hot transfer to serving dish. Garnish with parsley and sieved reserved egg yolks.

recipes.name: Sweetcorn Fritters
method: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and pepper into a bowl.
Add egg, mixing to combine.
Stir in sweetcorn.
Heat oil in frypan.
Drop in tablespoonful of mixture into pan.
cook until golden, and then turn and cook on other side.
Drain on absorbent paper.
Serve hot.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
method: Place noodles in ovenproof bowl, cover with hot water and stand for 30 seconds. Gently separate noodles and drain well.
Combine sugar and sauces.
Spray or brush pan with oil, heat and add egg and swirl pan to make a thin omelette. Cook until set, remove from pan, roll up and cut into thin strips ..
Brush or spray pan with oil if required, heat and add onion, shallots and garlic and cook until onion is transparent.
Add noodles, sauce mixture, peanuts, sprouts, coriander and egg and stir-fry gently until heated through.
Serve garnished with peanuts, coriander and lemon wedges

recipes.name: Thai Fish Cakes
method: Place fish, shallots, egg, basil, fish sauce and Thai curry fish paste in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Leave to stand in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
Form into fish cakes and shallow-fry until brown.
Serve with rice, lime wedges and chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
method: Slice onion thinly, cut rings in half and separate.
Brush or spray frypan with oil, heat and add garlic and onions.
Fry until well cooked. Remove from pan.
Sauté cabbage for 1 minute and remove.
Fry rice and carrot for 1 to 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to moderate, add stock and spice and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Add chicken to rice with soy sauce, sultanas, onions, garlic and cabbage.
Cook until rice is tender.

recipes.name: Mongolian Lamb
method: Cook rice and keep hot.
Brush or spray pan with oil and heat.
Stir-fry lamb, in two batches, for 2 to 3 minutes. Remove lamb and set aside.
Stir-fry the onions, garlic, shallots and chillies for 2 minutes.
Blend cornflour with soy sauce, oyster sauce and stock.
Return lamb to pan. Stir in cornflour mixture and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly thickened.

recipes.name: Chilli Con Carne
method: Heat oil in a large frying pan or saucepan.
Add onions, garlic and green pepper. Cook until onion is clear.
Stir in meat and cook until meat is browned.
Add chilli powder, water, tomato paste, oregano and season with salt to taste.
Bring to the boil, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat and simmer gently for 30 minutes or until mixture is quite thick.
Drain beans.
Add to pan.
Continue cooking for a further 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
method: Fry bacon until crisp
Cook spaghetti and drain
Beat eggs, cream and cheese
Add bacon to the pasta
Pour egg mixture into pasta
Toss well to combine.
Return to a low heat for a minute until sauce has cooked and slightly thickened.

recipes.name: Tuna Mornay
method: Cook rice.
Heat butter in a pan and cook onion until soft.
Remove from heat and stir in flour.
Gradually add milk over a low heat stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
When the sauce has thickened add rice, tuna and any vegetables. Sprinkle with cheese and bake until golden.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
method: Combine all ingredients except chicken in a food processor
Process until smooth
Place chicken in a non metal bowl, pour over all other ingredients and refrigerate overnight
Place on a greased rack in baking tray
Bake for 30 mins at 180 degrees.
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Noodle patties
method: Beat eggs with contents for flavour sachet
Prepare noodles according to instructions. Drain and stir  into egg mixture.
Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until crisp in both sides.

recipes.name: Rice and Red Lentil pilau
method: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the onion, garlic and 3 teaspoons garam masala. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes, or until the onion is soft.
Stir in the rice and lentils and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the stock and stir well. Slowly bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and all the stock has been absorbed.
Gently fluff the rice with a fork. Garnish with spring onion.

recipes.name: Potato Rosti
method: Boil potatoes for 10-15 minutes or until beginning to soften.
Drain and allow to cool
Grate potatoes
Put potatoes and onion and parsley in a large bowl.
Season with salt and pepper
Heat butter and oil in non stick frypan over medium heat.
When butter has melted, add potato mix to the pan, spreading out but not pressing too firmly.
Cover the pan and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until golden and crispy.
Halfway through cooking, check that it is not burning.
Turn by carefully flipping the whole rosti onto a plate then sliding it, upside down back into the pan.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until golden brown.
Cut into four pieces and serve.

recipes.name: pizza
method: Add ingredients to the bread maker in the order listed.
When the dough cycle is complete, divide the dough in two and roll each out until about 3 cm thick.
Top with tomato paste and other ingredients.
Bake in 200°C oven for about 20 mins.

recipes.name: Ginger Beef Stirfry
method: Cut meat into thin strips against the grain. Put meat, first measure of oil, first measure of soy sauce and ginger in a bowl. Leave to marinate for 30 minutes.
In separate bowl mix second measure of soy sauce, vinegar, cornflour, sugar and stock to a smooth paste.
Heat half the second measure of oil in a wok. Add the meat and quickly stir-fry until browned. Remove from wok.
Add peppers and spring onions to wok. Stir-fry until vegetables are bright in colour.
Add soy sauce mixture to wok and cook for 1 minute or until liquid boils and thickens.
Return meat to pan, quickly heat through and serve.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
method: Sauté onion and carrot for 2 mins.
Add mince and cook for 3 mins
Add stock, pepper and sauces and cook until well cooked.
Remove from heat and sir in flour mixed to a paste with  little water. Return to heat and stir until sauce thickens.
Pour into a pie dish and cover with boiled potatoes mashed with a little butter and milk.
Bake in a moderate oven until golden

recipes.name: Lasagne
method: — MEAT SAUCE
Heat oil in a pan. Cook onion, garlic and carrot until tender.
Add meat and stir until browned.
Add tomatoes, tomato paste, pepper and oregano and bring to boil.
Simmer for about 30 mins.
— BECHEMEL
Melt butter, add flour and mix until smooth. Cook for 1 min.
Gradually stir in milk and heat until sauce thickens and boils for 1 min.
Add pepper, nutmeg and cheddar cheese. Stir until melted.
Assemble lasagna in a flat ovenproof dish with layers of meat sauce, lasagna sheets and cheese sauce.
Finish with a layer of lasagna covered with cheese sauce. Sprinkle with parmesan and bake for 30 mins.

recipes.name: Corned Beef
method: Rinse beef in cold water to remove surface brine. Place into a heavy-based pot and cover with cold water.
Bring pot to boil, remove grey foam that rises to the surface, then reduce heat to a low simmer.
Add aromatics such as a bay leaf, brown sugar, onion and cloves. Then add chunks of carrot, celery and onion to flavour the beef delicately.
Adjust heat and maintain a simmer so small bubbles occasionally rise to the surface throughout the cooking time. Allow 25–30 minutes for each 500 g of beef.
A fork should easily penetrate the centre of the meat when ready. Once cooked, remove pot from heat and leave beef to rest in the cooling liquid.
— CHEF'S TIP
Most supermarkets sell corned beef with brining liquid in vacuum-sealed bags. Rinsing your cut before cooking avoids an overly salty taste.
You can also draw out excess salt by soaking corned beef in a bowl of cold water overnight.
Keep the cooking temperature at simmering point. *Boiling makes it dry and stringy, and you don't want that!

To serve corned beef cold, cook as per easy steps above. *Once steam from the liquid evaporates, place beef on a plate, cover with foil or plastic wrap and refrigerate immediately. Don't cool it completely on the kitchen bench.
— HOW TO CARVE CORNED BEEF
Place beef fat side up on the carving board, with the tip to the right of the carver.
Begin at the tip, slicing across the grain.
As the grain changes, turn beef so that you're always cutting across the grain for maximum tenderness.

recipes.name: Macaroni cheese
method: Melt butter in a saucepan.
Add onion and cook until clear.
Stir in flour and cook until frothy. Add mustard. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly until sauce boils and thickens.
Remove from heat. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in half the cheese.
Add macaroni, stirring to combine.
Pour mixture into an oven¬proof dish. Sprinkle over the remaining cheese.
Cook at 190°C for 20 minutes or until golden and heated through.
Note - Chopped cooked bacon or ham can be added to the sauce if wished.

recipes.name: Pasta and Sweet Potato Salad
method: Peel and chop sweet potato. Place in a baking dish, drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake in 200°C oven for 20 mins.
Cook pasta and drain.
Whisk 3 Tbsp of oil from feta with balsamic to make a dressing.
Steam asparagus until tender.
Combine, pasta, sweet potato, asparagus, leaves, feta, tomatoes and pine nuts. Toss with the dressing.

recipes.name: Pasta and Salmon
method: Melt butter in a saucepan. Add salmon, sir and sprinkle with lemon juice. Cook for a few mins.
Add cream, whiskey, salt and pepper. Cook very low heat for 5 mins.
Cook Spaghetti, drain and add to the pan. Toss gently.

recipes.name: Pasta with Salami and Broccoli
method: Cook Pasta. Drain
Cook broccoli with 1 Tbsp water and 1 Tbsp butter
Melt remaining butter and cook garlic. Add chicken stock, sour cream, mustard and bring to the boil.
Stir salami and shallots into the sauce.
Combine pasta, broccoli (including any juices) and sauce. Stir through parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Spicy Pork Fillet on Kumara Mash
method: Combine marinade ingredients. Pour over chops and leave to stand.
Heat onion in a pot with oil, garlic ginger. Add sweet potato and water and boil for about 7 mins. Water should have almost evaporated. Mash or Puree .
Take chops from the marinde and fry for about 5min each side.
Serve with beans and mushrooms and kumara mash

recipes.name: Pasta with Peanut Sauce
method: Cook spaghetti, and then drain.
Meanwhile, cut squash in half lengthwise, and slice halves.
Cook squash, capsicum, and shallots in water for 1-2 minutes or until crisp tender.  Drain.
Heat oil in frypan until hot.
Add garlic, stirring constantly for one minute.  Add peanut butter, stirring until smooth.  Stir in soy sauce, lime juice and sugar.
Add vegetables to frypan, tossing gently to coat.
Add spaghetti to frypan and mix.
Serve

recipes.name: Simple Beef Stroganoff
method: Sauté steak for 5 mins.
Add onions and mushrooms, sauté r 5 mins
Add wine and pepper, cook for 2 mins
Combine soup and sour cream and add to the pan. Cook until heated.
Serve with egg noodles

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
method: Combine first 4 ingredients in a small saucepan. Heat until marmalade melts.
Spray chicken with oil and bake for 10 mins at 200°C
Pour marmalade mixture over and cook at 180°C for 30 mins.
Serve with rice

recipes.name: Glazed Salmon Steaks
method: Combine first 3 ingredients and add fish and coat with marinade. Leave in the fridge for 1 hr.
Remove fish from marinade, reserving 3 tablespoons. Combine reserved marinade, brown sugar, honey and oil in a small saucepan. Bring to the boil and dissolve sugar.
Coat grill with oil and grill fish for 4 – 5 minutes per side basting occasionally with glaze.

recipes.name: Soy Lime Grilled Tuna
method: Place fish in a shallow baking dish.
Combine lime juice, soy sauce, ginger and cayenne pepper. Pour over fish.
Marinate in refrigerator for 30 mins, turning once.
Remove fish from marinade. Place marinade in a small saucepan, bring to the boil. Set aside.
Coat a grill rack with cooking oil. Grill fish for 4-5 mins each side, basting with marinade.

recipes.name: Curried red lentil soup
method: Heat oil in a saucepan. Cook onion and garlic for 3-5 mins. Add curry powder and cook for 30 sec.
Add lentils, tomato stock and 1 cup water. Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 20 mins.
Serve topped with sour cream and crusty bread

recipes.name: French Rissoles
method: Combine mince, leek, chopped sage, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Shape mixture into four 2cm thick rissoles.  Press two sage leaves into one side of each rissole.
Cook rissoles for 3-5 minutes each side or until cooked through.
Serve with mash, gravy and relish.

recipes.name: Felafel
method: Place onion, garlic, coriander, cumin, chickpeas, parsley, flour, egg white, salt and pepper in a food processor. Process until almost smooth.
Using floured hands, shape mixture into 8 patties. Refrigerate for 30 mins.
Heat oil and cook patties for 4 – 5 mins on each side.
Serve with tabouli, yoghurt and lavash bread.

recipes.name: Zucchini Slice
method: Combine all ingredients.
Pour into a well greased lamington tin.
Bake for 30-40 mins
Serve hot or cold

recipes.name: Red Chicken Curry
method: Heat oil in wok and cook garlic for 10-20 sec. Add curry paste and stirfry for a few more seconds before adding coconut cream.
Cook for 5 mins. Stir in fish sauce and sugar
Add chicken breast and cook for 3-4 mins or until chicken has turned white.
Pour in stock and bring to the boil and simmer for 1-2 mins to cook the chicken.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
method: Cut each chicken breast into three pieces, and make two or three shallow cuts into each piece. Put in a shallow dish.
Mix together the yoghurt, garlic, ginger, chilli powder, ground coriander, and lime juice.  Pour over the chicken, cover and marinade in the fridge for up to 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 200˚C
Arrange Chicken on oiled baking tray.  Bake in preheated oven for 15 mins or until golden brown and cooked
Heat butter and oil in wok, stir fry onion for 5 minutes.  Add chilli and garam masala and stir fry.  Stir in cream and marinade.  Simmer for one minute.
Add chicken pieces, cook for 1 minute, stirring.  Transfer to serving pan.  Stir chopped coriander into sauce.  Spoon sauce over chicken

recipes.name: Spagetti Amatriciana
method: Cook bacon in a frypan. Add onions and cook for 10 mins, until lightly browned.
Add tomatoes and chilli, season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook for 40 mins adding a little water if required
Cook spaghetti.
Combine pasta and sauce and serve.

recipes.name: Polenta with sausage
method: Prick sausages, cook in a dry frying pan for 5-6 minutes until fat runs.
Remove sausages with a slotted spoon
Heat oil in a saucepan, add onion, carrot, and celery and cook for two minutes.
Pour in tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and cook for 20 minutes.
Add sausages and cook for a further ten minutes.
Meanwhile, make the [[polenta]]

recipes.name: Quiche
method: Beat all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased pie dish.
Bake in a hot oven for 15 mins, then in a moderate oven for 15 mins
— BASE INGREDIENTS
|Salmon|Corn|Shallots|Cheese|Parsley|
|BBQ chicken shredded|Cheese|Asparagus|||
|Shredded ham|Onion|Cheese|Chives||
|roast cubes of pumpkin|fetta|cheese|Thyme||
|Zucchini|Peas|Brocolli|||

recipes.name: Steak Pizzaiola
method: heat oil and butter in frypan.  Add garlic and cook until brown, then remove and discard it.
Add steaks to pan, and cook for one minute on each side.
Season with salt and pepper, transfer to a plate and keep warm.
Add tomatoes and oregano to the pan and simmer for ten minutes until thickened and pulpy.
Return steaks to the pan and cook until done to your liking.

recipes.name: Steak in balsamic vinegar
method: Add oil and 20g of the butter to a frying pan. Cook steaks for 2-4 mins on each side. Season with salt and keep warm.
Add shallot to the pan and cook over low heat for 5 mins.
Add remaining butter (1 tsp) and reduce a little then stir in balsamic.
Pour sauce over steaks and sprinkle with parsley to serve.

recipes.name: Philippines Chicken
method: Heat oil and cook chicken until golden brown
Put all other ingredients in a saucepan over low heat
Pour mixture over cooked chicken
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until cooked through, basting occasionally.
Remove chicken from pan.  Stir one tbsp of hot water into the cooking juices
cook until heated through.
Serve in a sauce boat.

recipes.name: Cod with spiced red lentils
method: Put lentils in a saucepan with turmeric and stock. Cover and bring to the boil and simmer for 20-25 mins.
Heat oil in a frypan and add cumin seeds. When they start to pop, add the ginger and cayenne pepper. Stirfry for a few seconds and then pour onto the lentils.
Add the lemon juice and coriander and sir gently.
Lay cod on top of lentils, cover and cook for 10-15 min on low.
Serve sprinkled with coriander and a lemon wedge.

recipes.name: Chinese Chicken with cashew nut
method: slice chicken and combine with garlic, soy and cornflour
Refrigerate for 30 minutes
Heat oils in wok, stirfry chicken and juices until golden brown.
Add cashews and spring onions.
Stir fry for 2-3 minutes
Add cooked noodles and stir fry for 2 further minutes
Serve

recipes.name: Low fat fish and chips
method: Place potatoes on a tray
Coat with cooking oil (spray) and cook for 15 minutes
While potatoes are cooking, dip each fish fillet in milk and then coat in bread crumbs
Place on tray and coat with cooking oil (spray)
When 15 minutes are up, turn potatoes and add fish to the tray and return to oven for 20 minutes.
Turn fish after ten minutes and spray with cooking oil

recipes.name: Sweet and spicy chicken
method: Place chicken on baking paper lined tray.
Combine other ingredients and brush half on to top of chicken.
Bake in 180°C oven for 10 mins.
Turn chicken over and brush with remaining mixture. Bake for another 10 mins.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Steamed ginger fish
method: Place half the ginger in a lined bamboo steamer, top with fish and remaining ginger. Steam for 5-6 mins.
Sprinkle fish with half the shallots and coriander. Steam for a further 5-6 mins.
Stir soy sauce and oil in a small saucepan over medium heat for 1-2 mins.
Transfer fish to serving plate. Drizzle with soy sauce mixture. Sprinkle with remaining shallots and coriander. Serve with rice and lime wedges

recipes.name: Apricot Chicken
method: Skin chicken pieces, and arrange in a shallow casserole dish.
Blend soup with the apricot nectar and spices and pour over the chicken.
Bake in a moderate oven for 1 hour or until tender.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
method: Tear lettuce and place into a bowl.
Add capsicum, onion, tomatoes and cucumber.
Combine dressing ingredients and pour over.
Decorate with olives and feta.

recipes.name: Fried Rice
method: Spread rice on trays & leave to dry.
Lightly beat eggs and first measure soy sauce
Heat 1 tbsp oil in wok.
Pour in half the egg mix and cook until golden on both sides
Repeat with remaining egg.
Cut egg into 1cm wide strips
Set aside
Heat another tablespoon of oil and cook bacon until crisp. Remove from wok.
Cook garlic, ginger and shallots over low heat.
Add remaining oil and rice and stir fry for 5 mins.
Return egg and bacon to the wok. Stir fry to heat through.
Add second measure of soy sauce.

recipes.name: Coleslaw
method: Combine all ingredients.
Chill before serving

recipes.name: Irish Stew
method: Put lamb, potatoes, onions and stock in a large saucepan.
Cover and bring to the boil
Simmer for 1 ½ hrs or until meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Honey Ginger Chicken
method: Place chicken in baking dish.
Melt butter and our over chicken. Bake in moderate oven for 30 mins. Baste occasionally. Pour off excess fat.
Combine honey, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, ginger, stock and cornflour in a saucepan. Heat until it boils and thickens.
Pour over chicken and bake for 30 to 35 mins or until chicken is golden. Baste occasionally.

recipes.name: Kumara Soup
method: Melt butter in a saucepan. Add sweet potato, onion, potato and curry powder. Cook until onion is clear.
Stir in stock and bring to the boil.
Simmer until vegetables are tender
Puree until smooth.
Add milk and salt and reheat.

recipes.name: Minestrone
method: Heat oil and butter in a large saucepan. Add onions and cook until golden.
Add carrots, zucchinis, potato, cabbage and beans. Cook stirring frequently for 8 mins.
Stir in tomatoes, stock, drained kidney beans, salt and pepper.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 1 ½ to 2hrs until soup is thick.

recipes.name: Pea and Ham Soup
method: Put all ingredients in a large saucepan.
Simmer slowly for 2 to 3 hours until peas are soft
For a very creany Soup remove bones & puree soup in a blender
Cut meat from bones & return to soup

recipes.name: Pumpkin Soup
method: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add onion and cook until clear.
Add pumpkin potato & stock.
Cover, bring to boil and cook until vegetables are Soft.
Puree vegetables in food processor
Season with salt & pepper & nutmeg.

recipes.name: Baked Potatoes
method: 1.	Wash potatoes, and grease with oil
2.	Bake in moderate to hot oven for approximately one hour
a.	Cut a cross in the top of each potato
3.	Top with sour cream

recipes.name: Coconut Ice
method: Put icing sugar, milk, butter and salt in a saucepan.
Heat gently, stirring constantly until sugar dissolves.
Bring to the boil then do NOT stir.
Let mixture boil until it can be formed into soft balls.
Add coconut.
Remove mixture from the heat and allow to cool for ten minutes.
Divide mixture in half.  Add a few drops of food colouring to one portion and beat until the mixture starts to thicken.
Pour coloured portion into a buttered tin.
Beat the white portion until it starts to thicken.
Spread this mixture on top of pink mixture.
Allow to cool.
Cut into squares

recipes.name: Date Loaf
method: Put dates, water, soda and butter in a bowl
Stir until butter is melted.
Set aside for one hour.
Beat sugar, egg, walnuts and vanilla into date mixture.
Sift flour and baking powder into date mixture, stirring just to combine
Pour mixture into a greased 22cm loaf tin.
Bake at 180 degrees for 45 minutes or until loaf springs back when lightly touched
Leave in tin for ten minutes before turning onto a wire rack

recipes.name: Pavlova
method: Preheat oven to 150ºC.
Using an electric mixer, beat egg whites until stiff and it can form peaks.
Add sugar very gradually while still beating.
Slow beater and add vinegar, vanilla and cornflour.
Line an oven tray with baking paper.
Spread pavolva over an 18cm diameter, keeping the shape as even and round as possible.
Smooth top surface over.
Bake pavlova for 45 minutes, then leave to cool in oven.
Decorate with whipped cream and fresh fruit.

recipes.name: Peanut Brownies
method: Cream butter & sugar until light and fluffy
Add egg and beat well
Sift flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa together. Mix into creamed mixture
Add cold peanuts and mix well.
Roll tablespoons of mixture into balls.
Place on greased oven trays. Flatten with a floured fork.
Bake at 180°C for 15 mins or until cooked

recipes.name: Steak and Kidney Pie
method: Heat oil in a frypan.  Add meat in batches and quickly brown on all sides. Set aside.
Add onion and cook until clear.  Stir in flour and cook for 30 seconds.
Gradually add stock, stirring constantly.
Bring to the boil, return meat to the pan.
Stir in tomato puree and herbs.
Cover and cook gently for one hour or until meat is tender. ##Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer meat and vegetables to a 20cm pie plate or dish.  Pour ¼ cup of cooking liquid over the meat.  Reserve the remaining liquid, and allow to cool.
On a lightly floured board roll out pastry to 3cm larger than the pie and place the pastry strip all around.
Cover with pastry round, pressing edges firmly together.
Pierce holes in the centre of the pie.
Beat egg yolk and water together.  Brush over pastry.
Bake at 220ºC for 20 minutes or until golden and well risen.

recipes.name: Moist Coconut Cake
method: Soak coconut in milk for 2 hrs
Beat butter with sugar, add well beaten eggs.
Stir in sifted flour and salt, then add milk and coconut.
Bake in moderate oven for 45 mins.
''For cupcakes – double the recipe and bake for 30 mins

recipes.name: Almond Bread
method: Beat egg whites until stiff
Gradually add sugar and beat until dissolved
Fold in sifted flour and whole almonds
Pour into lightly greased loaf tin
Bake in moderate oven for 30-40 minutes. Turn out, wrap in aluminium foil, and put aside for two days
Cut into wafer thin slices
Place onto baking tray, and allow to dry out in a slow oven

recipes.name: Apple Slice
method: Mix cake mix, melted butter and coconut.
Press into greased lamington tin
Cook in moderate oven for 20 minutes.
Cool slightly
Cover with apples mixed with sour cream. Sprinkle with nutmeg and cook for further 15 minutes.
Cool slightly, cut into squares and refrigerate.

recipes.name: Crisp Coconut biscuits
method: Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in egg.
Add sifted flour, salt and coconut.
Roll in balls and press flat.
Dip top in sugar and place on greased oven tray.
Bake in moderate oven for 10-15 mins.

recipes.name: Pikelets
method: In a bowl put sugar, salt, sifted flour
Stir in beaten egg and milk, then add butter and soda dissolved in boiling water.
Cook spoonfuls on a flat pan.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Scones
method: Cream butter and sugar.
Add egg and pumpkin then add flour and salt.
Gently mix and add a little milk if it is dry.
Turn onto a floured surface and cut with scone cutter.
Bake in a hot oven.

recipes.name: Chocolate Self-Saucing Pudding
method: heat butter and milk in saucepan
Add vanilla
Add to flour, cocoa and sugar
Pour into ovenproof dish
Combine brown sugar and cocoa and sprinkle on top.
Pour over 2 cups hot water on the back of a spoon
bake in moderate oven for 45 minutes

recipes.name: Impossible Pie
method: Blend all ingredients together.
Pour into  greased pie dish.
Bake at 180°C for 1 hr.
The pie forms three layers.
Serve hot or cold

recipes.name: Boston Bun
method: Boil potatoes and mash - 1 cup required
mix all together
Pour into greased loaf tin
Bake for one hour in moderate oven

recipes.name: Banana Cake
method: Cream butter and sugar
Add eggs and vanilla
Add mashed bananas
Add milk and flour alternately
Bake in loaf tin (plus a half dozen cupcakes) in slow oven for one hour.

recipes.name: Frangipani Pie
method: Bring crushed pineapple to the boil. Blend cornflour, water and egg yolks and add to pineapple, stirring until thick. Set aside.
Place milk, sugar and pinch salt in a saucepan. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves.
Blend cornflour in water, add to milk stirring until thick.
Remove from heat and add coconut, butter and vanilla.
Spoon half the coconut cream into the pie shell. Add all the pineapple then the remaining coconut cream.
Top with meringue (3 egg whites and 4 Tbsp sugar)
Bake in moderate oven for about 15 mins.

recipes.name: Chocolate Spiders
method: Melt chocolate, and add peanut butter.
Add noodles and gently mix until covered with chocolate
Place heaped spoonsful onto greased tray
Refrigerate until set.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Pate
method: Trim white seams from livers, and rinse gently and drain
Note – take care to throw away any green portions as this will add bitterness
Heat 20g butter in a pan
Add half the livers and seal
Remove, and repeat with remaining livers
Add shallots and cook for two minutes.
Return livers to pan and add brandy.  Simmer for one minute
Place mixture into food processor and blend for 30 seconds or until smooth.
Rub through a sieve and return to food processor.
Add remaining butter and process for 40 seconds.
Season to taste with salt and pepper
Transfer to ramekins and cover with melted butter
— NOTES
If you use a nutribullet, you can avoid the sieve step.

recipes.name: Oaty Fruit Pancakes
method: Drain peaches, reserving juice.
Chop ½ cup of peaches and put in a owl with ¼ cup of juice.
Add milk, rolled oats, egg sugar and salt. Beat with a fork thoroughly.
Sift dry ingredients on to this. Add melted butter and mix just enough to combine.
Cook spoonfuls like pikelets.
Boil remaining juice, golden syrup vanilla and cornflour.
Serve pancakes with peach slices and syrup.

recipes.name: Grandma's Condensed Milk Tart
method: Prepare the pie shell.
Combine condensed milk and lemon juice and whisk until it thickens.
Combine fruit salad and custard powder, until there are no lumps. Heat until it boils and thickens.
Lay the condensed milk mixture in the bottom of the pie shell and lay the fruit salad mixture over the top. Refrigerate for a few hours until set.
Can be topped with any fruit you like

recipes.name: Chinese Coleslaw
method: Place the almonds in a small non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until toasted. Remove from heat and set aside for 5 minutes to cool.
To make the dressing, combine the vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil and peanut oil in a small bowl. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Place the almonds, cabbage, green shallot and noodles in a large serving bowl. Drizzle with dressing and gently toss until combined. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Fast Asian Fish
method: Place fish in a shallow baking dish.
Combine soy, ginger and sweet chilli sauce and pour over fish.
Cover with foil and bake in 200°C oven for 8 mins.
Serve with rice, drizzles with sauce and garnished with shallots

recipes.name: Ginger Ice Cream with Mango
method: Simmer milk and ginger over medium heat.
Whisk together egg yolks and sugar. Gradually stir into warm milk mixture.
Pour into a clean saucepan over low heat. Stir for about 10 mins until the mixture has thickened.
Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a large heatproof bowl. Discard ginger.
Add condensed milk and stir to combine.
Pour into a shallow container, cover with foil and freeze for 3 hrs.
Break up into a food processor and process until smooth. Quickly return the tray to the freezer for another 6 hrs.
Bring water and sugar to the boil until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and add mango and lime juice. Set aside for an hour to cool.
Spoon mango and syrup into bowls and top with ice cream.

recipes.name: Satay Sauce
method: Heat oil in a saucepan. Add onion and cook for 5 mins.
Add garlic and chilli and cook for 1 min.
Remove from heat and stir through peanut butter.
Place over low heat and add water, lemon juice, vinegar and sugar.
Stir while cooking for 3 mins until sauce thickens.

recipes.name: Chicken and Corn soup
method: Place chicken and stock in a large pan with 3 cups water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 mins. Transfer chicken to a bowl and strain stock into a jug.
Heat oil and cook onion, garlic and leek for 5 mins. Add the stock and bring to the boil.
Cut chicken into pieces and add to the soup with the noodles and creamed corn. Simmer for 15 minutes adding more water if it gets too thick.
Season with salt and pepper

recipes.name: Banana & Walnut Bread
method: Sift flour into a bowl. Add sugar, walnuts, soda and stir to combine.
Add egg, milk and banana and gently fold until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into a lined loaf tin and bake in a 180°C oven for 45 mins.
Set aside to cool completely

recipes.name: Corned Beef Hash Cakes
method: Boil potatoes and roughly mash. Set aside.
Add beef, mustard, eggs, salt and pepper to potatoes. Stir to combine.
Take ¼ cup of mixture and shape into a patty. Refrigerate for 2 hrs.
Heat butter and oil in a pan.
Roll patties in flour and cook in the pan for about 3-4 mins each side.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon and Zucchini Fritters
method: Combine eggs, oil, milk in a bowl. Add flour and whisk until smooth.
stir through salmon, zucchini, salt and pepper.
Cook spoonfuls for about 2-3 mins each side.

recipes.name: Sweet and Sour Vegetables with Cashews
method: Heat oil in a wok. Add onions and stirfry for 1-2 mins.
Add carrots,zucchini, broccoli and stir fry for 2-3 mins.
Add mushrooms, bok choi, sugar, soy, chilli sauce and vinegar and stirfry for 1-2 mins.
Sprinkle with cashews to serve.

recipes.name: Rissoles
method: Combine all ingredients together.
Shape into rissoles.
Cook for 3-5 mins each side.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Scrolls
method: Add dough ingredients to the bread maker in the order listed.
When the cycle has finished roll the dough out to 38 cm square.
Brush with half the melted butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Drizzle over the rest of the butter.
Roll up and cut into 2 cm slices.
place on a greased tray for 20 mins
Bake in preheated oven at 180°C for 20 to 25 mins.
Cool slightly an drizzle with blended glaze ingredients.

recipes.name: Pancakes
method: Sift flour into a bowl
make a well and add beaten eggs
Gradually add milk, water and butter, beating all the time until smooth.
Stand for an hour or overnight.
Grease a small pan and add enough batter for a pancake.
When batter has bubbles and edges are set, turn over to brown the other side.
Keep warm while others are cooked.
Serve with syrup or sugar and lemon juice

recipes.name: Hot Cross Buns
method: Add ingredients to the breadmaker in the order listed,
When the dough cycle is finished divide the dough into 16 pieces.
Place close together on a tray for 30 mins or until doubled in size.
Pipe on crosses and bake for 15-20 mins in a 190°C oven
Heat glaze ingredients in a saucepan and brush over buns while still hot.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
method: Beak egg whites and set aside.
Whip cream. Set aside
Beat egg yolks and sugar until thick and pale.
Add mascarpone and beat until just combined.
Fold in whipped cream.
Fold in egg whites.
Dip biscuits in coffee. Arrange half in the bottom of a deep serving dish.
Spread half the cream mixture over the biscuits.
Lay the rest of the biscuits on top followed by the rest of the cream.
Sprinkle with cocoa and refrigerate for 2 hrs or until firm.

recipes.name: Lemon Meringue Pie
method: In a saucepan, combine lemon rind and juice with the water.
Add butter and half the sugar and bring to the boil.
Mix cornflour and water to a paste and mix in egg yolks. Add to lemon mixture whisking for 5 mins or until thickened.
cover with greaseproof paper and leave to cool.
Beat egg whites with salt and cream of tartar to stiff peaks. Add remaining sugar and beat until glossy.
Spoon lemon into the tart shell, cover with meringue and bake for 12 to 15 mins or until meringue is golden.

recipes.name: Custard Squares
method: Cut pastry sheet in half. Place pastry between two oven trays and bake for 10 to 12 mins at 215°C. Set aside to cool
In a saucepan, mix custard powder, sugar and ¼ cup milk to a smooth paste..
Add the remaining milk, butter and egg. Cook until mixture is very thick, stirring all the time.
Cover with plastic wrap and leave to cool.
Spread custard between the pastry sheets and dust with icing sugar.
Can be iced with chocolate icing.//

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
method: Preheat oven to 180c
Peel apples, and cut into cubes
Place apples in a bowl, sprinkle with flour, sugar and cinnamon. Pour over lemon juice.
Toss then spread out evenly in a 1.5 Litre baking dish
— Topping
Place topping ingredients in a bowl (melting the butter first)
Mix until clumps form like wet sand.
Spread over the apples. Crumble with fingers as required.
Bake for 30-40 minutes until golden.
Cover loosely with foil to keep warm.
Stand for 10 mins before serving.
Serve with ice cream.

recipes.name: Ox Tail Stew
method: Toss ox tails in flour seasoned with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pan and brown meat well. Remove from the pan.
Peel and thinly slice onions and carrots. Fry onions and carrots in pan for 5 minutes.
Add stock, a few sprigs of parsley and bay leaf. Bring to the boil, stirring.
Return meat to pan, reduce heat, cover and simmer for 6 to 8 hours (in slow cooker) or until tender.
Allow to cool and skim off the fat. Remove bay leaf.
Reheat and serve with mashed potato.

recipes.name: ANZAC biscuits
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Combine the oats, coconut, flour and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Set aside. Place the butter, golden syrup and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until butter melts. Bring to a simmer and cook for a further 1-2 minutes until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat, cool slightly, then add the bicarb soda and 1 tbs water. Stir to combine, then pour over the oat mixture.
Using a wooden spoon, combine butter and oat mixture. Using 1 tbs mixture each, roll into 24 equal-sized balls. Divide between two baking paper-lined baking trays, leaving 3cm between each.

Flatten biscuits slightly, then bake for 10-12 minutes until the top tray is slightly golden. Swap trays and cook for a further 6-8 minutes until all biscuits are golden. Remove from oven and cool completely on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Golden Syrup Dumplings
method: Rub butter into flour and add egg to make a dough.
Divide into 8 and roll into balls.
Put all syrup ingredients into a saucepan and bring to the boil.
Add the dumplings and continue boiling for 20 mins.
Serve with custard.

recipes.name: Melting Moments
method: Beat butter and sugar until creamy.
Sift flours together and add gradually.
Roll mixture into balls and place on greased trays. Press with a floured fork.
Cook in a slow oven for 30 mins.
Join pairs with lemon icing once cooled.

recipes.name: Pressed tongue
method: Cover ox tongue with water, add salt and bay leaf and boil for about 3 hrs.
Remove the skin and slice if serving hot.
To press, put the tongue in a baking tray with a weight on top. (saucepan filled with water works well)
Place in refrigerator overnight. Slice thinly.

recipes.name: BBQ Tandoori Chicken
method: 1.	In a medium bowl whisk together the marinade ingredients.

2.	Rinse the chicken pieces under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place in a large, resealable plastic bag and pour in the marinade. Press the air out of the bag and seal tightly. Turn the bag to distribute the marinade, place in a bowl, and refrigerate for 6 to 8 hours, turning occasionally.
3.	Remove the chicken from the bag and discard the marinade. Wipe the marinade off the chicken with paper towels. Lightly brush or spray each piece with olive oil.

4.	Grill the chicken, skin side up, over Indirect Medium heat until the juices run clear. The leg and thigh pieces will take 40 to 50 minutes and the breast and wing pieces will take 30 to 40 minutes.
//For crispier skin, grill the chicken, skin side down, over Direct Medium heat during the last 5 to 10 minutes of grilling time. Serve warm.//

recipes.name: Baked Gnocchi with blue cheese
method: Make Gnocchi following separate recipe
Preheat oven to 180C. Bring cream to the boil in a small saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium then simmer for 2 minutes or until slightly reduced.

Add blue cheese to pan. Season to taste with pepper. Reduce heat to low-medium then cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes or until cheese has melted (don't worry if mixture isn't completely smooth).
Spread gnocchi over the base of a large, ovenproof baking or gratin dish. Scatter with prosciutto pieces then pour over the blue cheese sauce. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and parmesan.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until sauce is bubbling and crumbs are golden. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Gnocchi with mushrooms and sage butter
method: Cook the gnocchi and drain.

Meanwhile, heat one-third of the butter in a frying pan over medium heat until foaming. Add the mushroom and garlic, and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes or until soft. Transfer to a heatproof bowl. Remove the garlic and discard.

Wipe the frying pan clean with paper towel. Heat the remaining butter in pan over medium heat until foaming. Add the gnocchi and sage and cook, stirring, for 5-8 minutes or until the gnocchi and butter are golden and the sage is crisp.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the mushroom to the gnocchi mixture. Cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes or until heated through.
Divide the gnocchi mixture among serving bowls. Top with parmesan. Serve.

recipes.name: Lolly cake
method: melt butter, stir in condensed milk
Add biscuits, lollies and coconut.
Mix with hands.
Use baking paper with some coconut sprinkled on it.
Make it into a log then cover with coconut.
Refrigerate for 4 hours.
Slice.

recipes.name: Blueberry Turnovers
method: Combine cream cheese and 2 Tbsp of sugar and lemon rind in a bowl.
Spread a quarter of the mixture over a square leaving a 1cm border.
Sprinkle with ¼ of the blueberries.
Brush edge with egg and fold pastry over to form a triangle. Press edges with a fork.
Repeat for the other three and place on an oven tray.
Bush with egg and sprinkle wth sugar.
Bake at 220°C for 15 mins.

recipes.name: Pan Fried Camembert
method: Cut Camembert into equal wedges. Dust with Flour
Dip in egg yolk and then roll in crumbs
Mix Sweet Orange marmalade and Grand Marnier as a dipping sauce and set out with plates
Heat a half cm deep oil pool in fry pan
Stand each wedge one by one in hot oil and tip over when the last is added. work way around the wedges tipping each side in oil ( a deep fry basket could be utilized instead).
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Tandoori Salmon and Haloumi Kebabs
method: Mix Salmon and Tandoori paste. Leave to stand for 1 hr.
Skewer haloumi and salmon alternately onto bamboo skewers.
Cook in a pan or BBQ until Salmon is only just cooked.
Serve with a salad

recipes.name: Custard Kisses
method: Cream butter and sugar. Add egg. Mix in dry ingredients.
Drop ½ tsp of mixture on to cold greased trays.
Bake for 10 – 15 mins in a hot oven.
Cream icing ingredients and use as filling

recipes.name: Chocolate Cake
method: Place all ingredients in a bowl and mix until smooth.
Put into cake tins and bake in a moderate oven for 30 mins.
''Makes about 30 cupcakes (bake for 15 min)

recipes.name: Honey Snaps
method: Cream butter and sugar and add honey
Add flour, ginger, soda and salt.
Roll into balls and place on trays. Press flat with a fork.
Bake in a moderate oven until golden (10 – 12 mins)

recipes.name: Lemon Delicious
method: Cream butter and sugar, add egg yolks, rind and juice of lemon
Add flour and milk alternately
Add stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour into greased pie dish and stand in pan of hot water.
Bake for 45 mins in a moderate oven

recipes.name: Belgium Biscuits
method: Cream buter and sugar, add egg.
Sift dry ingredients and add to mixture to make a dough.
Roll out onto a floured board to about 3mm thick.
Cut 6.5cm rounds. Bake at 180°C for 15 mins
When cool, ice half the biscuits. Spread the rest with jam and place on top of iced biscuits.

recipes.name: Bacon and Egg Pie
method: Pre-heat oven to 180 degrees C.
Use tin container for best results with pastry (rather than glassware).
Grease tin lightly with butter and dust bottom with a little flour.

Line the bottom of dish with puff pastry.  Place strips of middle bacon across bottom piece of pastry;  crack 6-8 eggs on top;  finish with slices of tomato and spinach;  sprinkle with a little cracked pepper (no salt).
Top with puff pastry and close all edges over each other and press together with fork.
Using fork, make steam holes across top of pastry.  Place in centre of oven and cook for approx. 25 minutes at 180 degrees C (fan-forced) until nicely golden on top.  ENJOY!

recipes.name: Louise Cake
method: Pre-heat oven to 300F (150C).
Line tin with baking paper and allow the paper to over hang edges a little.
Cream together the butter and sugar. Add three egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Sift flour and baking powder together. Fold through the creamed mixture. The dough will seem quite crumbly, this is normal. Press dough into lined cake tin.

In a clean bowl, use an electric mixer to beat the egg whites until they form soft peaks. Gradually add 1/4 cup of castor sugar, a 1 tablespoon at a time, while continuing to beat the whites until they form stiff, glossy peaks. Use a spatula to gently fold in the desiccated coconut and vanilla essence.
Using a spatula, spread a thin layer of jam over the dough.
Next, spoon and spread the coconut meringue over the jam. Make sure all the jam is covered with meringue.
Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the meringue top is a soft pink eggshell color. It is normal for the meringue to crack, so don't panic.
Remove from oven and cool in tin for 2-3 minutes. Carefully remove the cake from the tin by holding onto the baking paper and gently lifting. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Broccoli and Ham Pasta Bake
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Cook pasta in a large saucepan of boiling, salted water following packet directions, until just tender. Add broccoli to saucepan 1 minute before pasta is cooked.

Melt dairy spread medium heat. Add onions and garlic. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute. Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 30 seconds. Remove from heat. Add milk, whisking until smooth. Return to heat. Add lemon rind. Cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until sauce comes to the boil. Simmer, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and add cream cheese and tasty cheese. Stir until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

Drain pasta and broccoli. Place in an 8-cup capacity ovenproof dish. Top with ham. Pour cheese sauce over ham and stir until well combined. Sprinkle breadcrumbs over pasta. Spray lightly with oil. Bake for 20 minutes or until golden and hot. Serve.

recipes.name: Gnocchi
method: Steam potatoes for 25 minutes or until tender.
mash while still hot
Stir in flour, egg and a pinch of salt
Knead to a soft elastic dough
Shape the dough into long rolls and cut into 2cm lengths
Press with a floured fork
Bring a large pan of water to the boil
Add gnocchi a few at a time
Remove with a slotted spoon as they rise to the surface

recipes.name: Pork and Spinach Dumplings
method: Combine pork, green onion, water chestnut, soy sauce and spinach in a bowl. Season with pepper. Using clean hands, mix until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Mix cornflour and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl to form a smooth paste. Place 1 heaped teaspoon pork mixture in the centre of 1 wonton wrapper. Brush edges of wrapper lightly with cornflour mixture. Fold over 1 edge of wrapper to form a triangle. Twist the edges to seal and enclose filling. Repeat using remaining pork mixture, cornflour mixture and wonton wrappers.

Line base of a large steamer basket with baking paper. Place wontons in a single layer in basket. Steam, covered, over boiling water for 5 minutes or until wrappers are tender. Place on serving plates. Serve with baby Asian salad greens and extra soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.name: Lemon Chicken
method: Combine the marinade ingredients. Place the chicken in a bowl with the lemon juice. Add the marinade ingredients and sprinkle the ginger pieces over the chicken.
Marinate the chicken for about 20 minutes.

Steam the chicken. If using the wok to steam the chicken, place the chicken on a steamproof dish and pour the marinade ingredients over it. Steam the chicken for about 40 - 45 minutes (until the chicken turns white).
Serve hot with rice and stir-fried dried mushrooms.  Garnish with shallots and lemon wedges

recipes.name: Steamed Dim Sum
method: Combine the mince, chillies, garlic and 1 tbs of the soy sauce in a bowl. Place in the fridge until required.

Brush a baking tray with 1/2 tsp of the oil to lightly grease. Dip the rice paper wrappers, one at a time, in a large shallow dish of lukewarm water for 30 seconds or until soft and pliable (do not leave the wrappers in too long or they will begin to tear). Place on paper towel to dry.

Place a tablespoonful of the beef mixture in the centre of each rice paper wrapper. Bring corners together to enclose mixture and gently twist to form a pouch. Repeat with the remaining rice paper wrappers and beef mixture.

Brush the base of a 30cm bamboo steaming basket with the remaining oil. Place the steamer over a wok or large saucepan of simmering water (make sure the base of the steamer doesn't touch the water) and cook, covered, for 4-5 minutes or until the dim sum are cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine the sugar, lime juice and remaining soy sauce in a small bowl. Set aside.
Serve the dim sum with the lime soy sauce

recipes.name: Steamed Pearl Balls
method: Place rice in a bowl. Cover with cold water and allow to stand for 30 minutes. Drain. Place in a shallow dish.
Preheat oven to 100°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper to keep balls warm after being cooked.

Combine mince, water chestnut, onion, carrot, ginger, soy sauce, sherry, oil and cornflour in a bowl. Mix well. Roll tablespoonfuls of mixture into balls. Roll each ball in rice, coating well. Place on a large plate.

Pour 2 cups water into a wok and bring to the boil over high heat. Line a large steamer basket with baking paper. Place half the meatballs in basket, allowing space between each ball. Cover with steamer lid. Place steamer over wok. Reduce heat to medium.
Steam for 25 minutes or until rice is tender. Transfer to baking tray and place in oven to keep warm. Repeat with remaining meatballs.
Serve meatballs with steamed baby bok choy and extra soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.name: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli
method: Mix and finely blend filling ingredients.
Mix pasta ingredients and pass through the flat rollers until you reach 5 or 6 on the regulating knob. Dough should be the same width as the rollers.
Attach the ravioli cutters. Fold the dough in half and insert into the centre of the rollers and turn the handle about a quarter turn.
Separate the two parts of the dough sheet onto either side of the rollers.
Place the hopper attachment on top and pour filling between the two sheets.
Turn the handle slowly filling the hopper as you go.
Place the ravioli sheet on a lightly floured cloth to dry for a few minutes (5-10 mins).
Separate the ravioli and cook straight away or store for 2-3 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Banana crepes
method: — MAKE CREPE BATTER
Put flour in a bowl.  Make a well and break in eggs.  Add 1 TBsp oil, and salt and a little milk.
Beat with a whisk to make light and smooth mixture.
Add remaining milk gradually until batter falls like a ribbon from whisk.
Rest batter in fridge for a few hours.
Bring back to original consistency with a little water or milk.
— MAKE CRÈME PATISSERIE
Scrape seeds out of vanilla pod, add them and pod to milk and bring to the boil in pan.  Beat sugar and eggs together in a large bowl.
Pour boiling milk over the egg mixture, a little at a time, stirring constantly.
Pour back into pan and cook on gentle heat.  Remove as soon as it boils and thickens.  Remove vanilla pod.  Add rum
Cook 12 crepes.
Preheat oven to 200º.
Peel bananas and cut lengthwise.
Put 1 TBsp crème patissiere and half a banana on each crepe and roll up
Grease a dish, and arrange stuffed crepes.
Bake 7-8 mins until golden brown and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon
method: In a large pan, fry onions and bacon until browned.  Remove contents, add meat and brown on all sides.
Add meat to the pan, and brown on all sides.  Sprinkle with flour, stir until browned, then add the hot stock.
Add the bacon, onions, wine and bouquet garni.  Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer gently on a low heat for two hours, then add mushrooms and cook for 30 minutes more.

recipes.name: Butterscotch self saucing pudding
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease a 1.5 litre (6 cup) ovenproof dish. Combine 1/4 cup of the brown sugar and all of the flour in a bowl. Add the melted butter, egg, milk and 2 tbs of the golden syrup and stir until combined. Spoon into greased dish.
Combine the remaining 1/2 cup of brown sugar and cornflour. Sprinkle over the pudding mixture.

Combine 1.5 cups boiling water with the remaining 2 tbs of golden syrup. Pour over the top of the pudding mixture and bake for 40-45 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Serve with double cream or ice cream.

recipes.name: Cauliflower soup
method: Separate cauliflower into florets, and add to 1.5L (6 cups) salted water and bring to the boil.  Cook for 15 minutes
Drain well, reserving cooking liquid.
Set aside a few florets for serving.  Puree the rest in food processor, the mix with the corn flour.
Thin to a good soup consistency with cooking liquid. Simmer for ten minutes.  Just before serving, thicken with egg yolks then add butter and reserved florets and season with salt as necessary.
I know how to cook – p 185

recipes.name: Chicken casserole
method: Preheat oven to 200º.  Heat butter in a heavy based pan, add bacon and onions and cook over a high heat until browned.
Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add chicken and brown on all sides.  Return bacon and onion to the pan and pour in the wine.  Season with salt and pepper.
Cover with a tight fitting lid and cook in oven for 40 minutes.  Add mushrooms to the pan and return to oven to cook for 20 minutes more.
I know how to cook –p451

recipes.name: Congolais
method: Line baking tray with buttered baking paper.  Preheat oven to 150º.
Put sugar, egg whites in a pan set over very low heat.  Stir to dissolve sugar.
Stir in coconut and vanilla
Put pyramid shaped piles of mixture on the prepared tray.
Bake 30-45 minutes or until golden brown.
I know how to cook – p770

recipes.name: Cream of onion soup
method: Melt 30gm butter in pan.  Add onions, and cook for ten minutes.  Sprinkle with flour and cook for two minutes, stirring all the time.
Stir in hot milk, and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 20 minutes.  Blend until smooth.  Simmer for a further ten minutes.  Beat egg yolk with remaining butter and add to the soup, stirring constantly.
I know how to cook – p 193

recipes.name: Creme caramel
method: Preheat oven to 150º
Make a dark caramel
70g of sugar and 1 TBsp water into a large clean pan.  Put on a low heat stirring until sugar dissolves.
Increase heat, and bring to boil without stirring
Remove from the heat when all water has evaporated and sugar is starting to caramelize, moving from light gold to deeper brown.
Stop cooking by adding one or two drops of iced water to the pan.
Pour caramel into mould to coat the sides.
In a large pan, bring milk, remaining sugar and vanilla to the boil.  Remove from heat.  Add eggs, stirring constantly.
Pour into prepared mould, and place mould in a roasting dish half filled with hot water.  Bake for 45-50 minutes until set.  Allow to cool.
I know how to cook – p704

recipes.name: Eclairs
method: — FILLING
Bring milk and vanilla to the boil.
Beat flour, sugar and eggs together in a large bowl.
Pour boiling milk over this mixture, a little at a time, stirring constantly.  Pour back into pan and cook over a low heat stirring constantly.  Remove from heat as soon as it boils and thickens.
— PASTRY
In a large pan, gently heat 120mL water, and sugar, butter and salt until butter has melted, then bring to the boil.
Quickly add all flour at once, and beat with a wooden spoon.  Reduce the heat and continue to beat the dough for about one minute until it comes away easily from the sides of the pan.
Grease a plate with butter and turn mixture out onto it and leave to cool to room temperature.
Return to pan and gradually beat in eggs until dough is smooth and glossy
— ASSEMBLY
Preheat oven to 200º and grease a baking tray with butter and baking paper.
Pipe or spoon dough into fingers on the prepared tray.
Bake for 20 minutes and allow to cool.  When cooled, slit éclairs along the side, fill and ice as desired
I know how to cook – p776

recipes.name: Egg custard
method: Preheat oven to 150º
Place milk, sugar, vanilla into a pot. Bring to the boil over a low heat.  Remove from heat, and add eggs, stirring constantly.
Pour into a dish and place in a roasting tin half filled with hot water, then bake in oven for 45 minutes.
I know how to cook – p703

recipes.name: Gougere
method: Heat ½ cup water, butter, salt, and cheese in a pan until melted.  Bring to the boil.
Add flour all at once, and beat with a wooden spoon.
Reduce heat, and continue to beat for one minute (until it comes away from the sides of the pan).
Grease a plate and turn mixture out onto it to cool to room temperature.
Return to the pan, gradually beat in the eggs until the mixture is smooth and glossy.
Pipe or spoon dough into a ring shape, sprinkle with extra cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes at 200° until risen and golden.
I can cook now – P 128

recipes.name: Hedgehogs
method: Melt butter, sugar, cocoa, vanilla and milk together
Add 2 cups rolled oats. Add more as needed
Roll into balls
Roll in coconut

recipes.name: Leek Gratin
method: Melt butter in pan.  Stir in flour and cook for 2-3 minutes to form a paste.  Gradually add water, stirring all the time to prevent lumps forming.  Simmer for ten minutes.
Prepare and cook the leeks whole.
Drain leeks well and put in a large ovenproof dish.  Coat with sauce, sprinkle with cheese and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
I know how to cook – p565

recipes.name: Leek soup
method: Put leeks and potatoes in a large pan with 5 cups of water, salt and pepper.  Bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Add milk and process until mixed
Add butter.  Serve
I know how to cook – p195

recipes.name: Lemon Mousse
method: Set a heatproof bowl, set over a pan of barely simmering water, whisk the sugar, lemon juice and zest, egg yolks and 3 TBsp water until thickened.
Remove from heat and allow to cool. Whisk egg whites until stiff and gently fold into the cooled lemon mixture.
Serve in one large bowl or individual bowls.
I know how to cook – p702

recipes.name: Mushroom soup
method: Cut 2/3 mushrooms into fine strips and add to 1.5L (6 cups) water.  Bring to a simmer.
Add thyme and cook for 20 minutes.  Remove and discard thyme.
Blend until smooth.
Return to pan and bring to the boil.  Chop remaining mushrooms and cook in butter until softened.
Mix rice flour with a little water to form a paste and add to the soup with the mushrooms.
Season with salt and pepper, add cream and cook for ten minutes.
I know how to cook – p 185

recipes.name: Onion tart
method: — PASTRY
Put flour in bowl.  Make a well, and add oil, salt and butter.  Rub butter into flour.
Moisten with water to bring dough together.  Briefly knead the dough by hand.  The faster the better.  Cover pastry with gladwrap, and leave to rest in fridge for 30mins to 24 hours.
Bring to room temperature before rolling out.  Roll into a circle 5mm thick and place in tart tin
— FILLING
Melt 60g of butter in pan, fry onions over a medium heat until all liquid is evaporated and onions are browning.
Stir in flour and eggs.  Season with salt and pepper, and add a little milk to loosen mixture if necessary.
Cover pastry with onion filling and bake for 30 minutes
I know how to cook – p562

recipes.name: Plain Omelette
method: Beat eggs, salt and pepper in a bowl
Heat frying pan and melt butter.
Pour eggs into the pan.
When eggs are set and small bubbles have formed around the edge, bring the edges of the omelette towards the centre with a fork.
Fold the half of the omelette nearest the handle towards the outside.
Slide onto plate.

recipes.name: Poached eggs
method: Fresh eggs are ideal.
Add one litre of water (500mL per egg) and vinegar to a pan.  Bring to the boil and simmer.
Crack egg into a cup and pour into the water.
Simmer for 3 ½ minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon.
Can be served with the following sauces:
White sauce
Béchamel sauce
Tomato sauce
I can cook now – p 143

recipes.name: Pork Jambalaya
method: In a large pan, slowly fry bacon for 5 minutes, or until the fat runs, then add onions.  Raise heat and fry for 5 minutes until softened.
Remove bacon and onions from the pan and brown the pork in the fat.  Return bacon and onions to the pan with the ham.
Pour in stock, bring to the boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in rice and herbs, season with salt and cayenne pepper.  Cook for a further 10 minutes or until rice has absorbed the liquid and is tender.
I know how to cook –p620

recipes.name: Potato salad
method: Place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat. Boil, uncovered, for 10 minutes or until tender when pierced with a skewer. Drain, then set aside for 30 minutes to cool completely. Cut in half and place in a large serving bowl.

Meanwhile, place the egg in a small saucepan of cold water. Bring to the boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium and gently boil, uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 12 minutes for medium-hard boiled. Drain and cool under cold running water. Peel and set aside.
Heat a small non-stick frying pan over high heat. Add bacon and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until crisp. Remove from heat.
Combine the mayonnaise, sour cream and garlic in a small bowl.
Add the bacon, gherkin, dill, green shallots and capers to the bowl with the potato. Gently toss to combine. Add the sour-cream mixture and toss to combine. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Cut the egg into quarters and arrange on top of the potatoes. Serve the potato salad immediately with grilled beef or lamb, if desired.

recipes.name: Rhubarb creme brulee
method: Preheat oven to 150º
Place rhubarb in a heavy based pan.  Add ¼ of caster sugar.  Cook over  gentle heat until rhubarb breaks down.
In a large bowl whisk egg yolks with remaining sugar until pale and thick.
Pour the cream in a pan, add vanilla and place over a high heat and bring to boil.
Add cream to the beaten yolks, skim off any bubbles form the surface.
Place a layer of rhubarb in the base of 8 ovenproof ramekins and bake for 5 minutes to dry out rhubarb and prevent it from splitting brulee mixture.

Pour brulee mixture over each ramekin.  Place pots in a roasting tin half filled with hot water and return to oven for 40 minutes or until just set.  Allow to cool.  To serve, top each brulee with brown sugar then caramelize with a blow torch until sugar melts
I know how to cook – p899

recipes.name: Sticky date pudding
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease and line the base of a 7cm deep, 22cm (base) cake pan.
Place dates and bicarbonate of soda into a bowl. Pour over boiling water. Allow to stand for 20 minutes.

Using an electric mixer, beat butter, sugar and vanilla until pale and creamy. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Using a large metal spoon, fold through date mixture and flour until well combined.
Spoon mixture into prepared cake pan. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Turn onto a plate.
Make sauce Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook, stirring often, until sauce comes to the boil. Reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Pierce pudding all over with a skewer. Pour 1/2 cup of warm sauce over warm pudding. Stand for 10 minutes. Cut into wedges. Serve with remaining sauce.

recipes.name: Stuffed mushrooms
method: Preheat oven to 200º.  Clean mushrooms, cut the stalks off and set aside.  Sprinkle the caps with a little oil.
Put the mushrooms on a baking tray, gills upward, and bake for 7-8 minutes.
Remove from the oven, turn over and allow to cool.
Finely chop the mushroom stalks.  Heat oil in  pan, and fry the onion, shallot and mushrooms until onions is translucent.
Add nutmeg and cook gently until mixture thickens.
Heap the mushroom and onion mixture into the mushrooms and sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a baking tray and drizzle with oil, and bake for 12-15 minutes.
I know how to cook –p526

recipes.name: Vanilla creme brulee
method: Preheat oven to 150º.
Mix together milk, cream, vanilla, and 100g of caster sugar.  Bring just to the boil, then remove from the heat and cool.
Beat egg yolks in a bowl with remaining caster sugar until white and creamy.  Pour milk over eggs and mix well.
Pour into individual ramekins.
Place dish in a roasting tin half filled with hot water.  Bake for 45-50 mins or until just set (custard must not boil)
Shortly before serving, sprinkle brown sugar and put the dish under a blowtorch or a grill to caramelize.
I know how to cook – p705

recipes.name: Steamed Pork Buns
method: Sift flour and baking powder into a bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and salt. Gradually add combined water and oil. Stir to form a soft dough. Turn onto a lightly floured surface. Knead until smooth.
Wrap dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Place soy and oyster sauces, rice wine, remaining sugar and cornflour into a jug. Whisk to combine.
Heat a wok or non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add sesame oil, pork and soy mixture. Cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes, or until mixture comes to the boil.
Set aside to cool.

Divide dough into 10 portions. Cover with a tea towel to prevent dough from drying out. Working with 1 portion at a time, roll dough into a 12cm round. Place a spoonful of pork mixture into centre of each round. Draw edges up to form buns. Pinch tops together.

Pour water into a wok or deep frying pan until it is one-third full. Bring to the boil over high heat. Line a bamboo steamer with baking paper and place over wok (make sure it doesn't touch water). Place 5 buns into steamer. Cover with steamer lid.
Cook for 15 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into centre comes out clean. Keep warm. Repeat with remaining buns. Serve.

recipes.name: Shortcrust Pastry
method: Sift flour. Cut in butter until it resembles fine breadcrumbs.
Stir in sugar.
Add egg yolk & water. Mix to a stiff dough.
Chill for 30 mins before using

recipes.name: Spinach and Ricotta Pinwheels
method: Combine ricotta, onion, carrot, thawed spinach.
Spread mixture on pastry. Sprinkle with cheese.
Roll up pastry and brush with egg.
Slice and lay on a baking tray.
Cook in a hot oven until golden (~20 mins at 220°C)

recipes.name: Candied Sweet Potatoes
method: Arrange potatoes in a greased baking tray.
Melt butter and sugar together in covered microwave 	dish on high for 2 minutes. Pour over potatoes.
Bake at 180 for 20 mins basting occasionally
Alternately cook 3 mins on high in microwave
The popular potato- best recipes pg 85

recipes.name: Chow Mein
method: Brown the mince
Add water and noodles and bring to the boil.
Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Fried Prawns with Garlic
method: Wash prawns and pat dry.
Heat oil in frypan. Stir in garlic, onion & ginger. Stir fry for 1 minute.
Add prawns and fry for 3-4 minutes
Stir in soy sauce, sherry and brown sugar. Serve straight from pan.
The new family cook book pg 51

recipes.name: Fruit and Chocolate Ices
method: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
Adjust sweetness of fruit ices by adding honey it desired.
Pour into popsicle moulds, insert sticks and freeze overnight
Anti aging cookbook Pg 172

recipes.name: Ginger Fried Chicken
method: Slice chicken diagonally into bite sized pieces. Place is a bowl. Mix with 1/2 tsp Salt and half the rice wine.
Peel ginger. Wash. Dry & slice lengthwise wafer thin. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt & leave to stand
Cut capsicums in smell triangular pieces.
Place all sauce ingredients except cornflour in a saucepan & heat stirring well. Set aside to cool  as soon as it comes to the boil
Squeeze out ginger. Add to sauce and leave to stand
Mix chicken with egg white and then with cornflour. Fry in shallow hot oil stirring and turning to prevent crisping or browning. Remove and drain
Heat 2 tbsp oil in wok. Stir fry garlic so seconds than add Capsicums and ginger (removed from sauce)
When capsicums are tender add chicken, sprinkle remaining rice wine. Pour over sauce. Stir fry at high heat
Chinese Cooking Pg 104

recipes.name: Healthy Meatloaf
method: Preheat oven to 180º
Line baking tray with baking paper.  Place mince, breadcrumbs, onion, carrot, tomato sauce, parsley and egg in a food processor bowl.  Season with salt and pepper.  Mix until well mixed.
Shape mince into 10x18cm rectangle and place on tray.  Bake for 25-30 minutes or until firm to the touch.  Remove from oven and drain excess fat.
Spoon barbecue sauce over top of meatloaf.  Return to oven and cook for further ten minutes or until top is glazed.  Stand on tray for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Quick Vanilla Ice cream
method: Beat egg yolks and sugar in a bowl until light and creamy
Using electric Mixer whisk through cream and milk until well combined
Return mix to fridge until well chilled
Put in ice cream machine

recipes.name: Russian Bortsch
method: Sauté beetroot & carrot lightly in half the oil.
Place water salt potato peppercorns bay leaves, tomatoes & sautéed beetroot & carrot in large saucepan.
Cover & simmer for 20 mins
In smaller saucepan, fry onion & mushrooms in remaining oil until golden brown. Add tomato soup & mix well.
Add to large pan of soup with cabbage & simmer for further 10-15 mins.
Vegetarian cookbook pg 14

recipes.name: Scones
method: Mix together.
Do not knead
Do not use metal spoon.
Cook at 180 º

recipes.name: Vanilla Frozen Yoghurt
method: Whisk ingredients together
Refrigerate for one hour
Put in ice cream machine

recipes.name: Regular items
method: N/A

recipes.name: Albert Square
method: Preheat oven to 180C
Line base of shallow 20cmx30cm slice tin with baking paper.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
Add eggs, a little at a time, beating after each addition, then beat in golden syrup then vanilla essence.
Fold in currants
Sift dry ingredients together, and fold in, alternately, with milk
spread into preapred tin.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the centre springs back when lightly touched.
— Icing
Sift icing sugar into a bowl, stir in vanilla, lemon zest and sufficient lemon juice to make a spreadable consistency.
When the base is cold ice and sprinkle with coconut
Cut into fingers or squares

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Mudcake
method: Line tin. Preheat oven to 130
Gently heat butter and dark chocolate until melted thoroughly, either in a microwave or on a very low setting over a pan of hot water
Combine brown sugar, coffee and water with the chocolate / butter mix and beat until smooth.
Lightly beat the eggs and add to the coffee liqueur. Then fold in the flours.
Beat the mixture on a slow speed. Beat until mixture is smooth and glossy.
Pour the mixture in the lined tin, and bake for 4-5 hours. Test with a skewer, or by gently pressing with your fingers. It is ready when the cake springs back up.

recipes.name: Pavlova Roll
method: Preheat oven to 150 degrees C. Grease and line a swiss roll or lamington tin.

Whisk egg whites until stiff, gradually whisk in sugar, beat well. Fold in cornflour, vinegar and vanilla. Spread mixture in swiss roll tin which has been greased with butter and lined with grease proof paper.
Bake for 15 minutes at 180 degrees C.
Remove from oven and allow to go cold in tin. It will shrink down when cooling. When cold turn onto a piece of sugared paper and remove the baking paper from the pavlova.
Spread with whipped cream, sliced strawberries, sliced bananas any fruit of your choice. Roll up like a swiss roll. Top can be sprinkled with castor sugar or grated chocolate.

recipes.name: Peach Muffins
method: Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.
Lightly grease 16 muffin cups, or place muffin papers in a muffin tin
In a large bowl, mix the flour, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix the oil, eggs, and sugar. Stir the oil mixture into the flour mixture just until moist.
Fold in the peaches.
Spoon into the prepared muffin cups.
Bake 25 minutes in the preheated oven, until a toothpick inserted in the centre of a muffin comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes before turning out onto wire racks to cool completely.

recipes.name: Sponge (Maureen's)
method: Put sugar in a small pot with water. Heat and bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
While the sugar is heating, beat egg whites until very stiff.
Cool the water and sugar mix a little but keep the mixture liquid, then add to the egg whites.
Beat again.
Add egg yolks.
Beat again.
Sift dry ingredients a little at a time into the mixture, fold very gently into the mixture.
Bake in 190 degree oven for approx 15-20 minutes in a 20 x 20 square tin lined with baking paper.

recipes.name: Chocolate Spread
method: Place all ingredients into a food processor with the sharp cutting blade and process on high for 1 minute or until smooth.
Place in an air tight container in the fridge.
Best eaten after being in the refrigerator overnight as it firms up quite nicely.
It should last 1-2 weeks if it's not all eaten by then.

recipes.name: Apple Tarte Tartin
method: Peel apples, cut into quarters, remove cores (cutting each quarter at the core so it has a “flat” side), and toss the quarters in a large bowl with the lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of the sugar.
Using a 20cm frying pan as a guide, cut pastry into a round slightly larger than the pan, prick with a fork.

Melt butter in a 20cm non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Cover with the remaining sugar. Cook over medium-low heat, shaking pan occasionally to spread around any dark spots that appear, until a rich caramel forms.

Place apple quarters into pan, rounded side down, arranging them around pan. Cut remaining apple to fill gaps. Cook the apples over medium heat for about 10 minutes until caramel is bubbling up in the pan, shaking pan occasionally to prevent burnt spots.
Lay the pastry over the apples, tucking any protruding edges around edges of pan.

Place the pan in the oven (200°C), cook for about 25 minutes, or until the puff pastry has risen and cooked. The pastry should be dry and flaky. Stand tarte in pan for 10 minutes before carefully turning out onto a serving plate. Serve with cream.

recipes.name: Bagels
method: 1.	Add ingredient to bread maker pan in order listed.
2.	Set bread maker to dough cycle and remove after first knead (approx 30 min).
3.	Divide dough into ~12 pieces. Form into balls and poke thumb through the centre to make the bagel shape.
4.	Place on a floured surface and allow to rise.
5.	Bring 7 cups water with a Tbsp sugar to the boil. Drop ~3 bagels in at a time (they should pop to the surface). Boil for 30 sec each side.
6.	Cool on a rack while the rest are boiled. Brush with beaten egg and bake for 15 min at 200°C.

recipes.name: Balkan Sausages with Rice Pilaf
method: Place garlic and half the onion in a food processor. Process until finely chopped. Add mince and process until smooth.
Combine mince mixture with cayenne pepper and egg. Shape into 12 sausages and refrigerate for 30 min.
Place rice, stock and remaining onion in a saucepan. Bring to the boil and cook for 15 min and stand covered for 5 min. Stir almonds and basil through.
Fry sausages for 8-10 min.
Serve sausages with the rice and tapenade.

recipes.name: Banana Muffins
method: Combine milk, egg, margarine, vanilla and bananas, and blend in a mixing jug.
Place flour and sugar in a large bowl. Mix in milk mixture.
Pour mixture into a greased muffin tray.
Bake for 20-25 minutes at 180°C.

recipes.name: Braised Sausages with Couscous
method: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add sausages and cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden. Transfer to a board. Thickly slice diagonally.

Add remaining oil and onion to pan. Cook, stirring often, for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender. Add tomatoes and 1 cup stock.  Season with pepper. Return sausages to pan. Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened slightly.

Meanwhile, bring remaining stock to the boil in a small saucepan over high heat. Remove from heat. Stir in couscous. Cover. Stand for 5 minutes or until stock has been absorbed. Stir with a fork to separate grains.
Stir olives into the sausage mixture. Cook, uncovered, for 3 minutes or until warmed through. Stir pesto through sausage mixture. Spoon the couscous onto plates. Spoon over sausage mixture. Serve.

recipes.name: Brekky Bars
method: Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan-forced. Grease a 3cm-deep, 17cm x 27cm (base) slice pan. Line with baking paper, allowing a 2cm overhang at long ends.
Combine flour, coconut, sugar, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, sultanas and apricot in a bowl. Whisk milk and egg together in a jug. Add to flour mixture. Mix to combine.
Spoon mixture into prepared pan. Smooth top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until firm. Stand slice in pan for 15 minutes. Turn out on to a wire rack to cool completely. Cut into 18 pieces. Serve.

recipes.name: Chocolate Brownie
method: Mix sugar, flour, cocoa, 2 Tbsp walnuts and 70g chopped chocolate.
Melt butter and 200g chocolate and add to dry ingredients.
Add beaten eggs and pour into a lined slice tin.
Sprinkle with remaining walnuts and chocolate.
Cook for 1 hr at 150°C.

recipes.name: Chocolate Ice Cream
method: Combine sugar, milk, salt and cocoa in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Place egg yolks in a bowl and gradually stir in about ½ cup of the hot liquid.
Return contents to the saucepan. Heat until thickened but do not boil.
Remove from heat and add chocolate. Stir until melted.
Pour into a chilled bowl and refrigerate for two hours, stirring occasionally
Stir in the cream and vanilla
Freeze using an ice cream maker.

recipes.name: Christmas Cake
method: Combine mixed fruit, cherries, pineapple, ginger and sherry. Cover and leave overnight.
Cream butter and sugar. Add vanilla.
